feature_unlimited_count_desc: The free plan keeps up to 3. With Premium, keep every work in progress — scarf, socks, hat and more.
feature_custom_stitches_desc: Add 50+ stitches such as bobbles, crossed stitches and popcorns, and reorder the buttons you use most, so patterned rows are recorded as they are.
feature_no_ads_desc: No video-ad prompt when saving and no banner at the bottom, so you can keep crocheting without interruptions.
trial_banner_subtitle: Try all features free for 3 days!
trial_period_info: After a 3-day free trial, you will automatically switch to the yearly plan (¥3,000/year)

coupon_instructions: Enter "amimono" on the promo code screen at checkout (it becomes free)
premium_tagline: Make crocheting more fun and efficient
subscription_info_body:
• Monthly plan: ¥300/month (auto-renews)
• Yearly plan: 3-day free trial, then ¥3,000/year (auto-renews, about ¥250/month)
• The free trial can only be used once
• You will not be charged if you cancel at least 24 hours before the trial ends
• You can cancel your subscription in the App Store / Google Play settings
• The subscription renews automatically unless canceled
• Purchases can be restored
• Functional links to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy are provided

data_safety_title: Your projects stay even if you cancel
data_safety_body:
• After cancelling, all saved projects (stitch records and notes) remain and you can keep working on them
• Back on the free plan, you can create new projects only up to 3 in total (existing projects stay usable), and the stitch buttons show the 6 basic stitches
• Your custom stitch buttons are kept in each project and come back when you resubscribe or restore purchases
